candidates.hypothesis_of_change: The current false negatives come from missing company-level orders, backlog, customer wins, financing/listing actions, and fresh guidance rather than from packet ordering.
candidates.expected_benefit: Recover winner-side causal events while preserving explicit status, issuer role, timing, materiality, and contradictions.
possible_side_effects: Historical news summaries may be noisy or repeated.
Extra source calls may raise cost without improving coverage.
Controls can also contain genuine positive estimate or contract evidence.
candidates.falsification_test: Reject if validation binary F1 does not improve or if recovered recall produces excessive false positives or cost under the frozen A/B/C contract.

data_source_specs.retrieval_rule: Reuse complete SEC filing bodies already archived for the case cutoff.
Retrieve bounded historical issuer news before broad theme news and preserve provider publication dates and URLs.
Resolve same-CIK filings and freeze complete bodies for transaction, financing, and listing-status evidence.

contrastive_discovery_prompt.template: Compare labeled discovery cases only. Seek company-level orders, backlog, customers, transaction status, financing/listing actions, industry-chain pull-through, and fresh guidance. Require status, issuer role, timing, materiality, source spans, contradictions, and counterexamples.

seed_signal_specs.name: Binding event causal chain
seed_signal_specs.hypothesis: A confirmed issuer event is discriminative only when it links external demand or a transaction to company orders, customers, capacity, revenue, margins, or capital runway.
seed_signal_specs.observation_cutoff_rule: all supporting sources available by prediction_time
seed_signal_specs.extraction_rule: Extract issuer role, counterparty, event family, binding status, amount/unit, event/publication dates, causal link, and supporting span; reject plans, awards to third parties, and repeated summaries.
seed_signal_specs.contradictory_evidence_rule: Downgrade proposed, delayed, terminated, non-binding, dilutive, or already completed-and-priced events.

seed_signal_specs.name: Fresh expectation change
seed_signal_specs.hypothesis: Fresh guidance, estimate, or backlog changes are useful only relative to the prior expectation baseline and evidence date.
seed_signal_specs.extraction_rule: Extract old and new expectation, direction, effective period, publication date, source, and whether price confirmation already occurred.
seed_signal_specs.contradictory_evidence_rule: Preserve lowered guidance, estimate dispersion, stale revisions, and contradictory operating evidence.

signal_merge_prompt.template: Merge discovery signals only when status, issuer role, timing, materiality, source traceability, counterexamples, and confounders survive review. Keep distinct event and expectation families separate. Do not use admission outcomes.

blind_analysis_prompt.template: Use only the anonymous point-in-time packet. Classify the fixed six-month maximum multiple as A, B, or C from binding event status, company-level causal transmission, fresh expectation changes, materiality, and contradictions. Cite supplied evidence refs and never output a probability.

candidates.hypothesis_of_change: Static financial facts improve risk interpretation but may consume context without restoring winner recall.
candidates.expected_benefit: Measure whether a cheaper event-only packet preserves discrimination and calibration.
possible_side_effects: Removing financial denominators can make materiality and liquidity risk harder to judge.
candidates.falsification_test: Reject the ablation if validation binary F1 or false-positive control worsens under the frozen A/B/C contract.

data_source_specs.retrieval_rule: Reuse bounded historical company-news summaries with publication dates and URLs.

contrastive_discovery_prompt.template: Compare labeled discovery cases using only source-backed company events and expectation changes. Preserve counterexamples and record where financial denominators are necessary.

seed_signal_specs.name: Event presence ablation
seed_signal_specs.hypothesis: A small source-linked event packet may be sufficient when the event is confirmed and fresh.
seed_signal_specs.extraction_rule: Extract issuer event, status, date, and source span without financial normalization.
seed_signal_specs.contradictory_evidence_rule: Preserve negative status, delay, termination, and dilution.

signal_merge_prompt.template: Retain only fresh, confirmed, issuer-linked event signals with source spans. Record missing materiality as a limitation. Do not use admission outcomes.

blind_analysis_prompt.template: Use only the anonymous event packet. Classify the fixed six-month maximum multiple as A, B, or C, cite supplied evidence refs, preserve contradictions, and never output a probability.
